FreshCart Supermarkets is a Croatian neighbourhood supermarket chain founded in 2008, with 46 stores across Zagreb, Zagreb County and Karlovac County and around 1,900 employees. It focuses on fresh local food, fair prices and knowledgeable, helpful service. Its “Ask the counter” promise reflects an emphasis on honest advice: trained staff help customers choose meat cuts and prepare them. Fresh meat is sourced largely from Croatian producers and supplied through the company’s own distribution centre and cutting room in Velika Gorica.

FreshCart values reliability, hygiene, friendliness and pride in good work. Store teams receive an introduction with an experienced butcher, paid HACCP refreshers and, where relevant, support for equipment training and master craftsman exams. Counter roles value practical experience as well as product knowledge. Teams work across shifts, with rotas shared in advance and shift swaps possible by arrangement. The environment can be busy, especially on Saturdays, and managers place strong importance on food-safety records and well-stocked counters. Benefits include a meal allowance, staff discount, Christmas bonus and public-transport allowance.

I hold a basic HACCP food hygiene certificate, renewed in 2024, and have practical HACCP knowledge, including twice-daily temperature and hygiene checks.

relevant_experience:
PROJECT: Wedding and party catering (Mesnica Kod Ante, 2022-2025)
- Prepared whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting for 3 weddings and about 10 family parties a year; ordered, butchered, seasoned and delivered on the morning of the event.
- Largest order: 4 lambs and 2 pigs for a 180-guest wedding in Samobor, 2024.

PROJECT: Shop sausage range (Mesnica Kod Ante, 2020-present)
- Developed the shop's lamb merguez recipe in 2020 and adjusted the ćevapi mix to 70% beef / 30% lamb after customer feedback.
- The ćevapi won 2nd place at the Zagreb County craft meat fair (Sajam mesnih proizvoda), 2023.
- Make about 40 kg of fresh sausage a week in the busy season.

PROJECT: Dry-aged beef trial (Mesnica Kod Ante, 2024)
- Ran a 6-week trial dry-ageing beef ribs (21 and 28 days) in a cabinet the owner rented; kept weight-loss and temperature records.
- The shop now sells dry-aged rib on pre-order only, about 15 kg a month.

PROJECT: Stall closing routine (Tržnica Dolac meat hall, 2017)
- Wrote the stall's one-page closing and cleaning checklist (slicer, mincer, counter, floor drain) after a market hygiene inspection remark; it is still taped inside the cold room door.
